correctness.rationale: Prime-index formula follows by Frobenius of Q, with a direct p=2 check, then an integer-index Fibonacci–Lucas identity. At p≠5, Q^{p²−1}=I mod p and lifts by p^{k−1}; at p=5, Q^20=I and its lifts prove all k≥2, while k=1 is controlled by 5|a or a factor 5. A Jordan expansion proves sharpness. Proper-divisor Fibonacci growth makes every exact cycle count positive. Finite program independently reproduces 27,540 prime-index, 25,920 prime-power, and 7,680 Möbius cases.
